normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents…“Ocean Ayer Main House,” a spacious 5 bedroom retreat in Seacrest Beach! Just steps from the iconic 12,000 Sq Ft Lagoon Pool with private beach access, this 3-story home features multiple balconies, a gas grill, and 7 bikes for exploring 30A. Sleeps 14 across 3 levels with designer furnishings and luxe amenities. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Location in Seacrest Beach Between Rosemary & AlysSleeps 14 Comfortably with 5 BedroomsAccess to 12,000 Sq Ft Lagoon Pool – One of 30A’s LargestPrivate Community Beach Access with Seasonal Tram7 Bikes Included for Guest UseMultiple Balconies & Outdoor Seating Areas Across 3 FloorsGourmet Kitchen with Stand-Alone Ice Maker & Seating for 6Gas Grill for Cookouts After the Beach*** LIVING AREAS ***Ocean Ayer Main House offers versatile living spaces designed for relaxation and connection. The main living area on the 1st floor is perfect for group gatherings, while each floor hosts ample outdoor seating with multiple balconies.1st Floor Living Room: Cozy coastal furnishings, flat-screen TV, access to porchMultiple Balconies: Ample Outdoor Seating across all 3 floors*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The spacious and fully stocked kitchen is designed to handle everything from beach snacks to gourmet dinners. A large island makes prep easy and doubles as a casual dining spot. Stainless Steel Appliances & Granite CountertopsStand-Alone Ice MakerOversized Island with Seating for 6Dining Area with Seating for 6+Open Layout Ideal for Entertaining*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Soak up the Seacrest sunshine across multiple outdoor spaces perfect for relaxing, dining, and enjoying the Gulf breeze. With access to the famous Lagoon Pool and private beach, your 30A days start and end in comfort.Steps to 12,000 Sq Ft Lagoon Pool & Private Beach AccessGas Grill for Easy Outdoor DiningMultiple Porches & Balconies Across 3 FloorsOutdoor Seating: 1st Floor Porch, 2nd Floor Balconies, 3rd Floor Balconies (Seating for 4–8)*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Primary Suite: King Bed, Flat-Screen TV, En-suite with Walk-In Shower & Soaking TubHalf Bathroom: Convenient for GuestsLaundry Room: Full-Size Washer & Dryer2nd Floor:Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunks, Flat-Screen TVGuest Bathroom: Shower/Tub ComboBunk Nook: Twin-over-Twin BunkGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Flat-Screen TV, En-suite with Walk-In ShowerPrimary Suite: King Bed, Flat-Screen TV, En-suite with Walk-In Shower3rd Floor:Guest Suite: King Murphy Bed, Sectional Sofa, Flat-Screen TV, KitchenetteGuest Bathroom: Walk-In Shower*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled between the iconic Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, Ocean Ayer Main House offers easy access to all the best Seacrest Beach has to offer. Located steps from the stunning 12,000 sq ft Lagoon Pool, you can also take a 4-minute bike ride to the beach or hop on the seasonal tram for a quick ride with all your gear. With 7 bikes provided, exploring the area has never been easier or more fun.Lagoon Pool: 12,000 sq ft paradise with zero-entry splash zone, waterfalls, and plenty of loungersPrivate Beach Access: Just a 4-minute bike ride or short tram ride to the pristine Gulf watersPeddler’s Pavilion: 2-minute bike ride to boutique shops, live music, dining, and seasonal nightlifeScenic Walking Trails: Perfect for exploration, relaxation, and enjoying nature's beautyWalkable & Bike-Friendly: Easy stroll or bike ride to Rosemary Beach (8 minutes) and Alys Beach (12 minutes)South Walton’s Tallest Sand Dunes: Unique and stunning natural feature in the area*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 40754STRO #: STR-040754
